biotools.summary: thaf is a command-line tool to extract transcript sequences from a genome FASTA file based on GFF3 annotation files. It can also generate transcript-to-gene mapping files compatible with tools such as Salmon.

credit.name: Audrius Meskauskas
credit.note: Verdanta is an early startup in Switzerland, providing curated RNASeq pipeline. Thaf is part of our software stack that is released open source.

documentation.note: README provides enough information to use the tool

function.note: Produce transcriptome file from genomic DNA and gff3
